![What's new in Hamstr 0.6.1](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Mailo037/Hamstr/v0.6.1/docs/images/releases/v0.6.1.png)

Hamstr 0.6.1 is a bugfix release for playlists, swipes and the library.

- Playlists reorder like the queue: drag a file by its handle and the row itself follows the finger. Holding a file opens its menu.
- A file taken off a playlist leaves the list at once instead of staying until the playlist is opened again.
- Swiped rows in the songs list and in playlists slide over their action like a card, as on the Stash page; an action's name only shows once it fits. Grid tiles no longer swipe.
- Playlist covers have their own layout for one, two and more files, so a list with a single file no longer looks tiny.
- With playlists shown in the list, a new playlist starts from the button at the top instead of a tile among the files.
- The file menu shows a song's cover square.
- The Video and Audio tabs go by what a file is, so stashed installers and other non-media files only show under All.
- "Stash this one instead" for a song locked with DRM closes the sheet and starts the YouTube Music download right away.

Signed APKs are available for arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a, x86_64 and all ABIs together. Verify downloads against `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
